name: Leaven Yeast
overview: Scripture clearly instructs the people of Israel to avoid leavened bread during the Passover, emphasizing its symbolic significance in their deliverance from Egypt. The removal of leaven represents purity and separation from sin, as seen in the command that no leaven be found in their houses for seven days and that only unleavened bread be eaten (Exodus 12:19-20). This practice commemorates their hasty departure from bondage, when they ate unleavened bread because they had no time to prepare leavened dough (Exodus 12:34, 39; 13:3-4). Thus, leaven serves as a powerful symbol within the covenant community, reflecting obedience and remembrance of God's saving power.
